string.text: Upscale with FSR 1 whenever the game resolution is lower than the window (borderless) or display (fullscreen) resolution. Toggling it resets the video device once.
Run FSR's Robust Contrast Adaptive Sharpening pass after the upscale.
0 is the sharpest result, every +1.0 halves the sharpening. AMD's default is around 0.2.
Set a resolution lower than your monitor in Options > Video (Borderless or Fullscreen mode) to use FSR. Requires the DX11 renderer and the modded exes.
